messages:
elaine.k: Heads up — our SI partner (NorthStar SI) needs SOC2 report + recent pen-test artifacts for the marketplace listing. They want everything uploaded by EOD Friday. Who can own?
ben.security: which specific artifacts do they want? SOC2 report PDF, raw vuln scan output, and pen-test exec summary?
sasha.eng: we can export Nessus/Qualys XML & the pen-test exec summary. Need to confirm redaction rules though.
jamal.legal: @elaine.k @linda.partners we need an attestation letter signed by security + legal before sending to partner. No customer data in artifacts.
linda.partners: I can coordinate the partner side and confirm the exact file recipients and SFTP vs presigned S3. Asking NorthStar now.
evidence-bot: Upload policy reminder: presigned URLs should be <= 7d TTL and artifacts must be encrypted at rest. See https://internal.redwood/docs/evidence-ingest
ben.security: plan: 1) SOC2 PDF (final) 2) pen-test exec summary (redacted) 3) vuln scan raw output (redacted) 4) attestation letter. Owners: SOC2 -> jamal.legal to confirm distribution; scans -> sasha.eng; attestation -> ben.security.
sasha.eng: quick note — raw XML contains hostnames/IPs. I'll run a redaction script and produce both a scrubbed CSV and the original for internal audit. Command I’ll use: `python tools/redact_scans.py --input scan.xml --policy marketplace`
jamal.legal: attestation template uploaded to /evidence/templates/attest_marketplace_v1.docx. I'll fill and sign electronically once Ben confirms text.
elaine.k: timeline check — EOD Friday is 48h. Can we do a minimal package by then? If not, ask for 1-week extension.
ben.security: we can get a minimal package (soc2 + exec summary + attestation) by EOD Fri. Raw scans may need an extra day for redaction.
linda.partners: NorthStar replied — they need presigned S3 links (readonly) and an upload manifest. TTL must be >=72h. They also want an owner contact for SOC questions.
jamal.legal: we can do presigned links but legal requires access logs and that links are single-use where feasible. Ben, add a short owner contact paragraph to the attestation.
ben.security: will do. Owner contact: security@redwood.ai, +1-555-0132, and I'll add a brief scope note.
sasha.eng: upload plan: I will upload to s3://redwood-marketplace-evidence/partners/northstar/1709456789/ and generate presigns with `aws s3 presign s3://... --expires-in 259200` (72h). I’ll paste links to a secure channel.
evidence-bot: Note: presign generation event will be logged to evidence-audit trail.
elaine.k: cool. @linda.partners, please confirm the exact recipient email so Jamal can route attestation. Also we need to redact any vendor internal IPs.
linda.partners: recipient is compliance@northstar-si.com. Confirmed. I'll DM them the expected manifest fields (file, checksum, owner, redaction-level).
ben.security: action owners: SOC2 PDF -> jamal.legal (to attach & approve) ; Exec summary -> sasha.eng ; Presigns & upload -> sasha.eng ; Attestation text -> ben.security. I'll do a quick review once uploaded.
elaine.k: thanks all. If anyone hits blockers, escalate to me and cc @cto.
sasha.eng: uploading minimal package now — will post presigned links here in 30m.
ben.security: quick reminder for the team: redact PII and customer IDs. Use policy `marketplace_redact_v3`.
jamal.legal: signing now. Will return signed PDF in 20m.
evidence-bot: Upload event: presigns generated for 3 files by sasha.eng at 1709460365 — links sent to secure channel.
